actions.text: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Energy and Natural Resources.
Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.
On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill Agreed to by voice vote. (text: CR H2115)
Passed/agreed to in House: On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill Agreed to by voice vote. (text: CR H2115)
DEBATE - The House proceeded with forty minutes of debate on H.R. 1453.
Considered under suspension of the rules. (consideration: CR H2115-2116)
Mr. Babin moved to suspend the rules and pass the bill.
Referred to the House Committee on Science, Space, and Technology.

dimensions.assessment: Affects Department of Energy personnel, congressional committees, and award recipients of clean energy demonstration projects.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary shall submit to the Committee on Science, Space, and Technology and... the Committee on Energy and Natural Resources... a report

dimensions.assessment: Creates a transparency and reporting obligation without altering the underlying funding or execution of the clean energy projects themselves.
dimensions.evidence: publish publicly available in digital online format, that contains... a copy of any initial contracts or financial assistance agreements

dimensions.assessment: No federal spending amounts or funding alterations are stated in the text.
Amends project management and oversight reporting requirements under the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act.
dimensions.evidence: Subsection (h) of section 41201 of the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act (42 U.S.C. 18861) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a recurring semiannual reporting requirement continuing indefinitely.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than six months after the date of the enactment of this paragraph and at least semiannually thereafter

missing_information: Administrative costs to compile and publish the reports
Total number of covered projects subject to reporting
importance_detail.rationale: Requires the Department of Energy to submit and publish online semiannual reports regarding clean energy demonstration projects, contract documents, milestones, and project modifications.
